dataset: Nominal Broad U.S. Dollar Index

access_method: Official H.10 weekly release archive for point-in-time values; Board Data Download Program and FRED series DTWEXBGS for current-history provenance checks only
license: U.S. federal-government statistical release; FRED requests citation to the Board source

unit_of_observation: Daily nominal broad-dollar index observation; H.10 weekly release page is the historical publication unit
publication_schedule: Mondays at 16:15 America/New_York; next business day after a Monday federal holiday
